Package data

Class ReportManager

java.lang.Object
data.ReportManager
Direct Known Subclasses:
SubscriberReport, TimeReport
public class ReportManager extends Object
Entity class representing report configurations and metadata generated for the restaurant management. Tracks report periods, generation timing, and categories.
